categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Deerma Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the small household appliances industry, focusing on three main product categories: home environment appliances, water health appliances, and personal health appliances. The company owns the 'Deerma' and 'Philips' brands, with Deerma focusing on home environment products and Philips on water and personal health products. It integrates independent R&D, original design, self-production, and direct sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs integrated product development (IPD) and product lifecycle management (PLM) systems to drive innovation and product iteration. It has established specialized R&D centers for cleaning health, water health, and personal health categories. Production combines self-manufacturing with outsourced manufacturing, supported by smart manufacturing bases, automated production lines, and comprehensive production management systems including APS, MES, QMS, and WMS.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Deerma serves a diverse consumer base seeking quality and innovative small household appliances, targeting segments such as home cleaning, water purification, and personal care. Its customers include domestic retail consumers, e-commerce platforms, offline distributors, and overseas markets. The company also engages in ODM business, supplying products to other brands like Xiaomi.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with domestic sales accounting for about 80% of revenue. It has expanded its global footprint with subsidiaries and sales operations in Southeast Asia, Japan, Korea, Europe, the Middle East, the United States, Vietnam, France, and other regions. Overseas sales grew by over 20% in 2024, reflecting its global expansion strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: Deerma operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, encompassing product design, manufacturing, and direct sales. It manages its supply chain through a centralized supply chain management center coordinating procurement, production, and logistics. The company integrates self-production of core components like motors and electronics with outsourced manufacturing and processing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, increasing R&D investment by over 25% in 2024. It focuses on technology planning, product innovation, and rapid iteration, leveraging digital tools and AI to enhance efficiency. Strategic R&D priorities include smart cleaning appliances, water purification technologies, personal health devices, and modular, scalable technology platforms. It also pursues global market adaptation and product customization.
categories.revenue_model: Deerma generates revenue primarily through product sales of small household appliances across multiple channels including online direct sales, e-commerce platforms, offline retail, and ODM contracts. It operates a dual-brand strategy and multi-channel sales model domestically and internationally. Revenue is recognized at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance, with diversified sales modes including direct sales, agency, and distribution.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the mature and increasingly competitive small household appliance market, facing both traditional brands and emerging players. It positions itself through differentiated product innovation, multi-brand strategy, and global expansion. Deerma leverages its strong R&D, manufacturing capabilities, and digital marketing to maintain competitive advantages in core categories like cleaning appliances and water health products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Deerma achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.53 billion, an 11.98% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 142.4 million, up 30.95%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 4.62 billion, growing 7.05% from the previous year. It has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, with increasing overseas sales and R&D investment supporting future expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Deerma emphasizes improving life quality through innovative, well-designed, high-performance, and cost-effective small appliances. Its dual-brand strategy targets diverse consumer needs with tailored products in home environment, water health, and personal care. The company differentiates itself by integrating technology innovation, smart manufacturing, and digital marketing to deliver products that combine functionality, aesthetics, and user experience, aiming to build strong brand loyalty globally.
